summary: When hallucinating, invent.c:currency() chooses a currency with ROLL_FROM(currencies), which expands to gameplay rn2(21). JavaScript currency() currently draws from the display RNG, so it omits the recorded gameplay RNG call and shifts the #attributes output.

source.branch: Hallucination is active; when amount != 1L, pluralize the selected name.

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/invent.c:1546-1555: currency() selects ROLL_FROM(currencies) only under Hallucination and pluralizes when amount != 1L.
nethack-c/upstream/include/hack.h:1493: ROLL_FROM(array) expands to array[rn2(SIZE(array))], proving the choice consumes the ordinary gameplay RNG.

nethack-c/upstream/src/insight.c:2009-2020 and 788-799: ^X calls enlightenment, whose basics_enlightenment invokes currency(umoney) for the wallet line. js/insight.js:3265 and 841-897 wires the same production path.

Saved v60 evaluation at challenges/evaluations/accepted-ef4963eb5ba2f7992cc8c6d92bd1ace9fb796678-v60.json: at step 198 screen cell row 15 column 28 differs (C s, JS z); C RNG index 2868 records rn2(21)=14 from currency(invent.c:1550), while JS has no corresponding core RNG call.

The fix is limited to js/invent.js:currency() and its focused currency test. The source function is otherwise already implemented; change the hallucinated selection to use rn2 and preserve the C currency list and pluralization.
